يستجوب (form X)

# يُسْتَجْوَبُ (yustajwabu) /jus.tad͡ʒ.wa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# يَسْتَجْوِبَ (yastajwiba) /jas.tad͡ʒ.wi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
